<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Flash Forge](/Feats.aspx?ID=4251) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 30

</column>

---

An artificial metal object forms in the hands of you or a willing ally within 30 feet. You can choose a level 0, common, handheld [weapon](Weapons.aspx) or piece of [adventuring gear](/Equipment.aspx?Category=1) of 1 Bulk or less. The item is entirely made from metal, making some items impossible or impractical to use (if it's unclear, the GM decides). You can make items with simple moving parts or magnetism, like a compass, poor lock, or merchant's scale. The item lasts for 10 minutes, but each time it's used, the user must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the item is destroyed after the action is completed.
name: Flash Forge
